name: 课税（计税/评估/争议）依据

map.房产涉税计算工具，支持契税、房产税、增值税等税费计算，根据评估价值和适用税率计算: A property tax calculator covering deed tax, property tax and VAT; it applies the applicable rates to the appraised value to derive the tax base and the tax payable.
map.📖 查看「课税（计税/评估/争议）依据 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Tax Base (Assessment / Valuation / Dispute) User Guide"
map.计税评估值 = 计税依据 × 税率: Taxable assessed value = tax base × rate
map.契税税率：90平米以下1%，90-144平米1.5%，非普通住宅3%: Deed tax rates: 1% below 90 sqm, 1.5% for 90-144 sqm, 3% for non-ordinary residential
map.增值税不满2年按5%征收，满2年免征(普通住宅): VAT is levied at 5% under 2 years and exempt from 2 years (ordinary residential)
map.房产税商业用房按1.2%从价计征: Property tax on commercial premises is 1.2% ad valorem
map.对计税依据有异议可申请评估复议: Objections to the tax base may be raised through an assessment review
map.📚 深度解析：二手房交易计税依据: 📚 In-depth: Tax Base for Resale Transactions
map.买卖前估算契税、: Estimate before a sale the deed tax,
map.判断满二、满五唯一等免税条件能省多少税。: Work out how much the two-year and five-year-only-home exemptions save.
map.非住宅（商铺/办公）交易按从价计征房产税。: Non-residential (shop or office) deals are charged property tax ad valorem.
map.评估值 300 万、首套且面积≤90㎡ → 契税 1%=3 万元；满五唯一住房: Appraised value 3 million yuan, first home, area 90 sqm or less: deed tax at 1% = 30,000 yuan; a five-year only home
map.免征；满 2 年增值税免征；税费合计仅 3 万。: is exempt; VAT is exempt from 2 years; total tax comes to just 30,000 yuan.
map.不满二非唯一: Under two years, not the only home
map.同样 300 万、非唯一且不满 2 年 → 契税 1.5%=4.5 万、增值税及: On the same 3 million yuan, not the only home and under 2 years: deed tax at 1.5% = 45,000; VAT and surcharges = 300/1.05 × 5% × 1.12 ≈ 160,000; personal income tax at 1% = 30,000, for a total of about 235,000 yuan.
map.满五年指契税完税或产证满 5 年，唯一指家庭省内唯一住房；两个条件都满足方可免征: Five years means five years since deed tax was paid or title issued; only-home means the family's sole dwelling in the province. Both conditions are needed for the personal income tax exemption.
map.含税价需先还原为不含税收入再按 5% 计征，即 成交价÷1.05×5%，避免税上: The tax-inclusive price is first converted to a tax-exclusive amount and then taxed at 5%, i.e. price ÷ 1.05 × 5%, so no tax is charged on tax.
map.房产涉税计算工具支持契税、增值税及附加、房产税和个人所得税等多种税费计算，根据房: The property tax calculator covers deed tax, VAT and surcharges, property tax and personal income tax, applying rates automatically by property type, area and holding period to derive the tax base and the tax payable.
